name: God's Protection
overview: Scripture reveals that God's protection is both a divine promise and a present reality for His people, as seen in His assurance to Abram that He is a shield and great reward. God’s presence accompanies His followers wherever they go, safeguarding them until His purposes are fulfilled. The protection of God is depicted as mighty and strengthening, enabling His people to withstand adversaries and receive abundant blessings from heaven and earth. This protection extends beyond physical safety, encompassing deliverance from evil through the redeeming power of the Angel of God.
